body:
Investigated founder report of '30 items in priority, is that right, maybe caching issue' via CLI + live DB (var/iduna.db) + unified event log cross-check: 30 is real and correct, not stale -- a real bulk move of ~37 cards priority->cruise succeeded and is durable (cruise=49); a separate untouched set of 30 stayed in priority; repeated within-column drag/sort produced a bursty repeated-move log signature that looked like cards jumping back but never crossed queues. No caching bug in this specific incident, but none of the kanban endpoints sent Cache-Control at all -- added explicit no-store server-side (page/cards/inbox) + cache:no-store on the board's own fetches + the requested manual Refresh button. go test ./... clean, service rebuilt and restarted live. Commit 60b5afa.

⚓ ☃
title: KBUX-CACHE-001: kanban no-store headers + manual Refresh button
